verdict.rationale: Scraped and enriched results can be pulled out programmatically: /runs/{id}/result returns run data, webhooks POST full results on completion, and the SDK lists runs with pagination. That gives a de facto JSON export path for data. Nothing documents exporting job or enrichment configurations, a dedicated bulk export, or any portability or anti-lock-in guarantee. Missing for 10: documented export of job/enrichment configurations, bulk data export in a standard format (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), explicit migration/portability guidance, independent corroboration.
